text:
QUOTE: "Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and leave the `_MACRO` options undefined" (runtime) vs. "Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`" (compile time)
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter. It never says the two are mutually exclusive, and it admits it can't confirm that the macro mode excludes the runtime pointers.
